title: `**bold *italic bold***` renders with a stray asterisk
spec:
This is the Python-Markdown library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `python3 run_tests.py`. When italic text closes at the same point as the bold text around it, the output is wrong. ``` markdown.markdown('This is text **bold *italic bold*** with more text') ``` Expected: ```

This is text bold italic bold with more text

``` Actual: ```

This is text bold *italic bold* with more text

``` Similar inputs are probably affected too; please fix the underlying problem rather than just this case.
acceptance: the reported example produces the expected output
the underlying problem is fixed, not just the reported input
